resource.name: Install Implementation Guide
resource.description: Install FHIR packages (implementation guides) into the current project: their profiles, extensions, ValueSets, CodeSystems, ConceptMaps, NamingSystems and SearchParameters. Name a package to fetch it from the package registry, or upload its .tgz. Each installed package is recorded as an ImplementationGuide whose id is the package name. Installing a package that is already installed replaces it with the version given. Everything is written in one transaction.

parameter.name: package
parameter.documentation: A package to fetch from the package registry: 'name@version' (or 'name#version'), 'name@6.1.x' for the newest patch, or 'name' alone for the latest version. Example: 'hl7.fhir.us.core@6.1.0'.

parameter.name: npmContent
parameter.documentation: A package tarball (.tgz), base64 encoded. Its dependencies are taken from the other uploaded tarballs first, then from the package registry.

parameter.name: dependencies
parameter.documentation: Also install the packages these depend on (default true). A dependency that is already installed, in any version, is left as it is. The FHIR core packages are built in, and the server skips the large terminology packages (hl7.terminology, VSAC, PHIN VADS) unless they are named directly.

parameter.name: examples
parameter.documentation: Also install the example resources of the packages named or uploaded (default false). Dependencies' examples are never installed.

parameter.name: package
parameter.documentation: One for each package considered: the ones asked for and their dependencies.

part.name: version
part.documentation: The version installed, or for a skipped package the version asked for.

part.name: status
part.documentation: installed (it was not installed before), updated (it replaced an installed version) or skipped (see reason).

part.name: previousVersion
part.documentation: For updated, the version it replaced.

part.name: resources
part.documentation: How many of its resources were written.

parameter.name: outcome
parameter.documentation: Warnings about resources that were not installed, for example a resource that could not be read or whose id is taken by a resource the package did not install.

resource.name: Uninstall Implementation Guide
resource.description: Uninstall a package that $install installed in the current project: delete the resources it installed and its ImplementationGuide record. Packages it depends on stay installed.

parameter.name: version
parameter.documentation: The installed version. When given and another version is installed, nothing is uninstalled.
